reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and I don't buy supplements unless a doctor tells me to. One form of magnesium for $30 a month doesn't change that.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? And nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium, so why pay $30 a month for it.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor saying I should take magnesium, or a blood test showing I'm low.
